basis: Frozen policy revision2; user project decisions, not new official competition clauses

decisions.decision: Preparation may prepare task-private mini dependencies/approved assets and lightweight non-training checks; shared environments/Hainan excluded
Task/group exact aggregate scores and technical diagnostics may enter curated preparation/training guidance; no row valid truth/residual/lookup or reconstructive tiny groups/differences
Use train.Y during selection; valid remains for scoring/analysis. Final train+valid refit is a separate future user decision
Controller may register bounded future recovery within original science and approved total budget, reconciling job/checkpoint identity first; completed current learning must not restart
